item.title: Trump Says Talks Are On, Iran Denies It: What’s Really Happening?
item.description: Conflicting narratives are emerging around possible diplomacy between the United States and Iran. Donald Trump has pointed to “productive” discussions to end the war, but Iranian officials insist no talks have occurred. As the war continues, the gap between these claims raises important questions.

item.title: On Daily Life in Gaza: Angelina Jolie Shares a Young Woman’s Heartbreaking Letter
item.description: Angelina Jolie shared on her Instagram a moving message from a 26-year-old woman in Gaza who recounts the harsh realities of life post-war.

item.title: A Song for Every Mood: Ahmed Saad Announces a Five-Album Plan for 2026
item.description: Ahmed Saad just dropped a musical curveball: he’s working on five full albums for 2026, each with its own distinct identity. There’s the dramatic and melancholic album, the lighthearted one we all love, a summer-ready techno and house album, an album paying homage to classic Arabic music, and the wildcard, a full orchestral album. This ambitious plan also explains why we saw less of him during Ramadan, as he devoted himself entirely to bringing these diverse musical visions to life.

item.title: A KitKat Shipment Was Stolen, Here’s What Brands Across the Region Did Next
item.description: 12 tons of KitKat were stolen from a shipment en route from Italy to Poland, and the Arab world didn’t miss a beat. Somehow the real story became how every brand suddenly had something to say about it. Brands across the region are expressing concern, offering chocolate, and casually insisting they have absolutely nothing to do with anything. Do we believe them? Not one bit.

item.description: Taha Desouky just dropped the news of his upcoming standup special, Ana Zy El Fol. Here’s a look at the comedy roles that made us fall head over heels for his humor.

item.title: 5 Rooftops That Change How You See Alexandria
item.description: There’s something about Alexandria from above. Rooftops give you a different pace, the sun dipping into the sea, a breeze off the Mediterranean, and the city spread out below. If you want to unwind, or just escape the street-level buzz for a bit, here are the rooftops worth checking out.

item.title: 5 Arab Creators Sharing Their Stories on Autism
item.description: Awareness is important, but understanding comes from listening. This World Autism Day, we’re turning to Arab creators who are opening up their worlds and sharing the realities of autism as they live it. The result is a collection of stories that feel honest, nuanced, and impossible to reduce to a single definition.
